# Get iTunes Artist Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the iTunes artist.

## Syntax

~~~~text
artistDetail(property: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, note: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
artistDetail(property: Genre, note: Artist)
~~~~
